title: Ocean Sentinel Permanent Incident Learning Register

incidents.title: Authoritative P2-R2-C2 artifacts mutated in place during P3 without successor versioning
incidents.root_cause: P3 guardrail tests failed due to missing top-level disclosure fields; the agent edited existing authoritative artifacts in-place to resolve the failures rather than establishing successor versions.
incidents.failed_assumption: Modifying metadata in-place is benign because dataset sample bytes and partitions were not altered.
incidents.impact: Artifact SHA256 hashes diverged from historical inventory records, creating version ambiguity.
incidents.resolution: Formal version lineage established in ops01_p3_c1_version_lineage_v1.json; clean successor artifacts ops01_physical_dataset_manifest_v4.json and ops01_dataset_sufficiency_v5.json created.
incidents.permanent_rule: Never modify a closed authoritative artifact in place without an explicit version transition.

incidents.title: Historical hash recovery executed as unbounded repository scan and became stuck
incidents.scope: Repository-wide recursive filesystem search in python script background process
incidents.root_cause: Script crawled all directory trees and large binary files looking for arbitrary hash strings without timeout or scope constraints.
incidents.failed_assumption: An unbounded search would quickly finish across thousands of untracked test/experiment files.
incidents.impact: Process was interrupted/cancelled by user after context timeout.
incidents.resolution: Replaced with bounded best-effort search targeting authoritative records (found in ops01_p3_artifact_inventory_v1.json within seconds).
incidents.permanent_rule: Bounded investigation is mandatory. Never launch unbounded recursive searches across the repository.

incidents.title: Reproducibility Level B used without formally defined operational criteria
incidents.root_cause: Assigning a qualitative grade without a formal operational evidence contract.
incidents.failed_assumption: Reproducibility levels are self-explanatory intuitive grades.
incidents.impact: Risk of overclaiming pipeline reproducibility while DATASET_GENERATION_METHOD = NOT_DIRECTLY_VERIFIED was active.
incidents.resolution: Created ocean_sentinel_reproducibility_levels_v1.json formally defining Levels 0, A, B, C, D with explicit evidence criteria and boundary prohibitions.
incidents.permanent_rule: Every reproducibility level must have a precise operational definition and evidence requirement.

incidents.title: Part-I SHA discrepancy narrative wording error (7E vs 7F (erroneous 7B character transcription prohibited))
incidents.root_cause: Transcribing typo from prompt/report narrative without verifying exact hash characters.
incidents.failed_assumption: Narrative typo accurately reflected the discrepancy.
incidents.impact: Minor documentation wording error regarding the 7E vs 7F discrepancy.
incidents.resolution: Narrative corrected across telemetry and metadata to 7E vs 7F; regression test added prohibiting 7E vs 7F (erroneous 7B character transcription prohibited).
incidents.permanent_rule: The correct documented discrepancy is 7E vs 7F (never 7E vs 7F (erroneous 7B character transcription prohibited)). Verify hashes directly from filesystem.

incidents.title: Missing permanent epistemic disclosures in manifest_v3 and sufficiency_v4
incidents.root_cause: P2-R2-C2 omitted holdout selection disclosure and pilot hypothesis status from top-level metadata.
incidents.failed_assumption: Disclosures in report text were sufficient without manifest field persistence.
incidents.resolution: Incorporated into manifest_v4 and sufficiency_v5 with explicit lineage.
incidents.permanent_rule: Permanent epistemic disclosures must be present in all authoritative manifests.

incidents.title: OPS-01 DataLoader incompatibility with TrujilloTileDataset
incidents.root_cause: TrujilloTileDataset assumed 2-band 512x512 input, while OPS-01 is 1-band 256x256.
incidents.failed_assumption: Existing repository components are reusable across dataset candidates.
incidents.impact: DataLoader gap must remain open (OPEN-LOADER-001) until EXP-07 protocol is defined.
incidents.resolution: Formally recorded OPEN-LOADER-001 and OPEN-LOADER-CONTRACT-001 without premature loader implementation.

incidents.title: OPS-01 raw amplitude DN value domain requires unresolved scientific protocol decision
incidents.root_cause: Tiles are stored as uncalibrated raw amplitude DN, not calibrated sigma0 or dB.
incidents.failed_assumption: Satellite imagery is automatically physically calibrated.
incidents.impact: Value domain choice must be frozen by experimental protocol before training.
incidents.resolution: Recorded OPEN-PREPROC-001 decision record documenting trade-offs without premature choice.
incidents.permanent_rule: Value domain (raw DN / dB / sigma0) is an open scientific decision (OPEN-PREPROC-001).

incidents.title: Taxonomy terminology drift in C1 report tables
incidents.scope: C1 report narrative and audit tables
incidents.root_cause: Human-readable descriptive names used instead of canonical class names.
incidents.failed_assumption: Informal descriptive names do not affect taxonomy integrity.
incidents.impact: C1 report claimed OF was Class 8 lookalike; MCC was called Microalgae Bloom.
incidents.resolution: Replaced with canonical ops01_taxonomy_v1.json names and added strict guardrail.
incidents.permanent_rule: Canonical taxonomy file (ops01_taxonomy_v1.json) is the absolute semantic authority.

incidents.title: LWA evaluated as sufficient with only 1 independent parent scene
incidents.scope: OPS-01 dataset population and sufficiency evaluation
incidents.root_cause: Sufficiency evaluated by class presence in tiles rather than parent scene diversity.
incidents.failed_assumption: Class present in dataset implies sufficiency.
incidents.impact: OPS-01 candidate was non-compliant with diversity contract.
incidents.resolution: Ingested 2 additional Sentinel-1 IW scenes containing LWA to reach 3 independent parents.
incidents.permanent_rule: Never evaluate a criterion by class presence; evaluate literal contractual conditions.

incidents.title: Overstated pre-P3 unchanged claims where direct before/after evidence was not demonstrated
incidents.root_cause: Conflating current filesystem hash matching with proof of historical byte-level equality when pre-P3 manifest JSON had been mutated in-place.
incidents.failed_assumption: Current file integrity proves historical artifact identicalness.
incidents.impact: Epistemic overclaim of PROVEN_UNCHANGED without direct pre-P3 binary comparison.
incidents.resolution: Re-evaluated all claims in ops01_p3_c2_evidence_boundary_reconciliation_v1.json; used STRONGLY_SUPPORTED and PHYSICAL FILE CONTENT CURRENTLY VERIFIED.
incidents.permanent_rule: Never promote current-state consistency into historical-state equality. Use PROVEN only when direct before/after evidence exists.

incidents.title: Git state interpretation risked repeating '0 staged = clean' error without complete porcelain evaluation
incidents.scope: P3-C1 final closure report and git audit
incidents.root_cause: Reporting 'working tree clean' based on 0 staged mutations while ignoring tracked modified files and untracked artifacts.
incidents.failed_assumption: 0 staged changes means the working tree is clean.
incidents.impact: Violation of fundamental governance rule GOV-RULE-018.
incidents.resolution: Executed complete 4-command git inspection in ops01_p3_c2_git_state_audit_v1.json; explicitly classified working tree as NOT_CLEAN due to untracked files and tracked modifications.
incidents.permanent_rule: 0 staged != clean. The full working tree state must always be reported from git status --porcelain -uall.

incidents.title: Canonical taxonomy wording in governance layer used shortened class name for HM
incidents.root_cause: Informally shortening 'Artificial / Anthropogenic Objects' to 'Anthropogenic Objects' in governance text.
incidents.failed_assumption: Informal shortened names are acceptable in high-level narrative summaries.
incidents.impact: Taxonomy terminology drift within the governance rules themselves.
incidents.resolution: Audited against ops01_taxonomy_v1.json; corrected all occurrences to exact canonical class_name 'Artificial / Anthropogenic Objects'.
incidents.permanent_rule: Canonical class names must strictly match ops01_taxonomy_v1.json. Shortened or informal synonyms are strictly prohibited.

incidents.title: Reproducibility Level B required narrower operational semantic wording
incidents.root_cause: Broad phrasing at risk of being casually interpreted as 'OPS-01 dataset is fully reproducible'.
incidents.failed_assumption: Level B label alone prevents misinterpretation by future sessions.
incidents.impact: Potential overclaim regarding pipeline reconstruction or source reproducibility.
incidents.resolution: Narrowed canonical operational statement in ops01_p3_c2_reproducibility_language_audit_v1.json to 'OPS-01 verification artifacts satisfy Level B deterministic verification reproducibility'.
incidents.permanent_rule: Level B applies strictly to deterministic audit verification of stored files, never to pipeline or source reconstruction.

incidents.title: Source Control noise caused by large untracked generated/scientific artifact population
incidents.scope: Repository git status and Source Control usability
incidents.root_cause: Phase 6 external evaluation prediction payloads (1,800 .npz/.json files, 11.9 GB) and OPS-01 masks were left unignored without an explicit data tracking policy.
incidents.failed_assumption: Assuming existing .gitignore rules for trujillo_part_iii_eval covered all subsequent evaluation attempts.
incidents.impact: Source Control panel flooded with 2,230 untracked files, masking meaningful project modifications.
incidents.resolution: Formulated ops01_p3_c3_data_tracking_policy_v1.json and added narrow .gitignore rules for Phase 6 evaluation payloads and OPS-01 masks without deleting any files.
incidents.permanent_rule: Generated artifacts must have an explicit retention policy: tracked, ignored-retained, externally reproducible, or temporary.

incidents.title: Risk of solving Source Control cleanliness through destructive deletion
incidents.scope: Repository physical data and provenance integrity
incidents.root_cause: Common operator/agent urge to achieve a 'clean' Git status by running git clean -fd or deleting untracked files.
incidents.failed_assumption: Equating untracked files with disposable garbage.
incidents.impact: Would result in irreversible destruction of physical dataset masks, candidate evaluation records, or evaluation payloads.
incidents.resolution: Enacted GOV-RULE-031 and GOV-RULE-032 strictly prohibiting deletion of untracked files for hygiene purposes.
incidents.permanent_rule: Repository hygiene must never be achieved through deletion of scientific evidence or untracked artifacts.

incidents.title: Risk of .gitignore hiding authoritative scientific artifacts
incidents.root_cause: Blanket ignore rules (e.g. data/, experiments/, *.pt) risk hiding critical manifests, governance rules, and model checkpoints from version control.
incidents.failed_assumption: Assuming file extension or directory name is sufficient to decide ignore status without inspecting authority.
incidents.impact: Authoritative files like best_model.pt or metadata manifests become invisible and un-auditable.
incidents.resolution: Established protected artifact allowlist audit in ops01_p3_c3_gitignore_audit_v1.json and ops01_p3_c3_ignore_regression_audit_v1.json.
incidents.permanent_rule: .gitignore must never hide authoritative scientific artifacts; protected allowlist verification is mandatory.

incidents.title: Need for every AG task to self-audit and self-repair its own side effects
incidents.scope: Agent execution lifecycle and governance adherence
incidents.root_cause: Prior agent tasks completed execution leaving minor assertion discrepancies or side effects that required follow-on corrective phases (C1, C2, C3).
incidents.failed_assumption: Assuming tasks can declare COMPLETE without executing an end-to-end self-audit of their own modifications.
incidents.impact: Accumulation of subtle discrepancies across prompt boundaries.
incidents.resolution: Instituted mandatory 7-step self-healing lifecycle codified in GOV-RULE-037 and GOV-RULE-038.
incidents.permanent_rule: Every state-mutating task must audit, discover, and repair its own side effects before declaring COMPLETE.

incidents.title: Conflation of historical UI snapshot with final post-phase Git state
incidents.scope: Repository Git state reporting and telemetry consistency
incidents.root_cause: Measuring Git counts at an intermediate stage (e.g. baseline or pre-report capture) and using that intermediate count in executive summaries after new artifacts (reports, tests) were generated.
incidents.failed_assumption: Assuming the intermediate baseline count remains valid after subsequent closure artifacts are created.
incidents.impact: Apparent mismatch between intermediate baseline (288), pre-C4 UI snapshot (291 = 2+289), and final post-C4 Git state (293 = 2+291).
incidents.data_layer_affected: Audit reports / Telemetry / Source Control documentation
incidents.resolution: Enacted GOV-RULE-041 requiring final Git inspections to be measured strictly after all phase artifacts are authored, distinguishing intermediate states from final truth.
incidents.permanent_rule: Every final repository-state claim must be measured after all artifacts for that phase are created: INTERMEDIATE GIT STATE != FINAL GIT STATE; HISTORICAL UI COUNT != CURRENT FILESYSTEM TRUTH.

incidents.title: C5 timeline omitted phase-created telemetry artifact from final count reconciliation
incidents.scope: Repository Git state reporting, timeline accounting, and telemetry tracking
incidents.root_cause: C5 execution created scratch/phase_8_p3_c5_run_state.json as an artifact but omitted it from the timeline enumeration, creating ambiguity as to whether it was an untracked Git-visible artifact or an ignored artifact.
incidents.failed_assumption: Assuming all created files either increment Git untracked count or are self-evidently ignored without explicit categorization in timeline.
incidents.impact: Discrepancy between the list of newly created artifacts and the Git untracked delta (+2 vs +3 files), leading to ambiguity in post-C5 Git accounting.
incidents.resolution: Classified scratch/ telemetry as IGNORED_ARTIFACT per .gitignore:50:scratch/ (+0 Git porcelain impact), updated C5 report and telemetry, enacted GOV-RULE-042 through GOV-RULE-045.
incidents.permanent_rule: A phase-created telemetry file is itself part of the repository-state timeline if Git-visible, and must be explicitly classified if ignored.

incidents.title: P0-C1 declared calibration infeasible without searching for external metadata recovery
incidents.description: P0-C1 concluded that sigma0 calibration is INFEASIBLE because local annotation XMLs are not calibration XMLs. However, the calibration XMLs are publicly accessible via AWS S3 for all 27 parent products. The conclusion was correct for local artifacts but incorrectly generalized to overall infeasibility.
incidents.root_cause: Failure to distinguish between local artifact absence and general metadata absence
incidents.corrective_action: Proved all 27 calibration XMLs accessible via S3 HEAD/GET requests

incidents.title: LUT smoothness used as sole proof that block-mean calibration is equivalent to pixel-level calibration
incidents.description: P0-C1 analysis showed calibration LUT varies <0.01%% over 10-pixel blocks and concluded this makes block-mean calibration negligibly different from pixel-level. This analysis addressed only ONE of TWO error sources. The second source (mean(DN)^2 != mean(DN^2) by Jensen inequality) introduces ~6%% systematic bias independent of LUT smoothness.
incidents.root_cause: Incomplete decomposition of approximation error into independent sources
incidents.corrective_action: Analytical nonlinearity analysis showing ~6%% bias; empirical validation planned (V-01)

incidents.title: P0 claimed supervised segmentation constitutes representation learning without additional evidence
incidents.description: P0 scientific question claimed EXP-07 would produce representations useful for oil-spill discrimination. Supervised cross-entropy segmentation produces task-specific features, not general-purpose representations. Representation learning claims require explicit evaluation (e.g., transfer learning, feature probing).
incidents.root_cause: Conflation of supervised task optimization with representation learning
incidents.corrective_action: Reformulated EXP-07 as phenomenon segmentation. Representation quality is a hypothesis to be tested, not a guaranteed outcome.

incidents.title: Theoretical calibration nonlinearity required empirical validation across stratified parent products
incidents.description: C2 identified the Jensen inequality nonlinearity theoretically (~6% bias, CV~0.25), but left open the empirical question of actual error magnitude across real parent products, diverse incidence angles, and heterogeneous scenes.
incidents.root_cause: Relying on theoretical speckle models without empirical verification against parent measurement TIFFs
incidents.corrective_action: Executed V-01 empirical validation on 12 stratified samples (777,611 blocks) from 9 independent parents, confirming 5.81% mean bias, 5.52% median bias, and E1 < 0.01%.

incidents.title: Uncapped median-frequency loss combined with class-presence sampler risks severe double-correction gradient explosion
incidents.description: Simulation revealed that pairing a class-presence sampler with uncapped median-frequency loss multiplies rare-class gradients by over 3600x relative to background, creating severe risk of model divergence and false positive explosion.
incidents.root_cause: Analyzing loss weighting and sampler strategies in isolation without evaluating compound multiplier interactions
incidents.corrective_action: Adopted Hybrid Sampler (F) and Square-Root Median Frequency loss (E), bounding effective rare-class emphasis to ~43.5x.

incidents.title: Conflation of effective optimization batch size with BatchNorm statistical batch size
incidents.description: P0-C4 claimed gradient accumulation (steps=2, virtual batch_size=16) stabilized BatchNorm running statistics. Gradient accumulation aggregates gradients across backward passes for optimizer updates, but each forward pass computes BatchNorm batch statistics solely over the physical minibatch (size 8).
incidents.root_cause: Conflating optimizer optimization batch size with neural network layer-level statistical evaluation windows
incidents.corrective_action: Formally separated physical minibatch (8), effective optimization batch (16), and BatchNorm statistical batch (8). Classified small-batch BatchNorm variance as an explicit documented risk under Option B and verified momentum=0.05 smoothing.

incidents.title: Runtime input domain terminology mismatch (uncalibrated aggregated DN vs calibration pathway)
incidents.description: Protocol and contract documents described the runtime pipeline as an EMPIRICALLY_CHARACTERIZED_APPROXIMATE_CALIBRATION_PATHWAY, while the actual runtime pipeline ingests raw aggregated Sentinel-1 GRD detected pixel DN counts transformed with log1p and standardization, without applying radiometric calibration LUTs (A_sigma). This created ambiguity between empirical characterization of aggregation error and actual runtime model input domain.
incidents.root_cause: Describing the input domain using the name of the upstream validation study rather than the literal mathematical operations performed on model inputs
incidents.corrective_action: Formally classified model input domain as AGGREGATED_RAW_DN_LOG1P_STANDARDIZED, prohibited describing uncalibrated DN as calibrated backscatter, enacted GOV-RULE-060 and GOV-RULE-061.

incidents.title: Candidate F Hybrid Sampler prose description contradiction in C8 reporting (50/50 narrative vs 70/30 code and config)
incidents.description: The human/agent summary in Phase C8 reported Candidate F as '50% stratified tile sampling targeting rare classes, 50% uniform tile sampling', whereas the frozen protocol, machine-readable training configuration (exp07_p0_c8_final_training_config_v1.json), and actual runtime execution (scripts/train_exp07.py and src/ocean_sentinel/ml/exp07_reference.py) strictly implemented and executed the 70% parent-balanced / 30% class-presence formula (w_hybrid = 0.70*w_parent + 0.30*w_presence).
incidents.root_cause: Agent narrative hallucinated an informal 50/50 heuristic phrase in chat response text instead of directly transcribing the authoritative machine-readable configuration metadata.
incidents.corrective_action: Forensically audited the runtime code and sampling sequence, confirmed bitwise fidelity of the 70/30 implementation, verified that 1,944 draws matched the frozen stationary distribution, enacted GOV-RULE-065.

incidents.title: Model parameter count reporting discrepancy in C10 report (14,328,268 reported vs 14,310,860 actual)
incidents.description: The C10 report stated in prose that the model had 14,328,268 trainable parameters. Forensic introspection of the instantiated PyTorch ResNet18UNet model, both best checkpoints, all machine-readable training configurations, and automated regression tests confirmed the actual count is exactly 14,310,860 trainable parameters (14,322,666 total state elements).
incidents.root_cause: Typographical transcription error in report markdown; prose numbers were not directly validated against module parameter introspection.
incidents.corrective_action: Programmatically verified model parameter and buffer counts across both checkpoints and code; corrected reporting record; enacted GOV-RULE-069 and regression test.

incidents.title: Taxonomy abbreviation drift: Class 6 (Ocean Front) described as 'Oil Film' and Class 13 renamed to 'Ship'
incidents.description: C10 report prose described Class 6 (OF) as 'Oil Film' and Class 13 (HM) as 'Human-Made / Ship'. In the authoritative taxonomy ops01_taxonomy_v1.json, OF is Ocean Front (hydrodynamic water-mass boundary) and HM is Artificial / Anthropogenic Objects. Mineral oil spill (OS, label 14) was strictly quarantined and excluded from training.
incidents.root_cause: Agent narrative hallucinated domain interpretations for abbreviations without checking ops01_taxonomy_v1.json and violated GOV-RULE-011 and hm_naming_rule.
incidents.corrective_action: Audited complete taxonomy mapping; strictly enforced canonical definitions; enacted GOV-RULE-072 and regression tests.

incidents.title: Sensor physical modality hallucination: SAR radar backscatter cross-section described as 'acoustic'
incidents.description: C10 report prose referred to 'acoustic diversity' and 'acoustically similar dark-slick phenomena'. Sentinel-1 is a microwave synthetic aperture radar (SAR) operating at 5.405 GHz measuring electromagnetic radar backscatter; no acoustic or sonar channel exists.
incidents.root_cause: Linguistic drift in narrative generation conflating underwater acoustic sensing with spaceborne radar remote sensing.
incidents.corrective_action: Audited and expunged all acoustic references from SAR analysis; enacted GOV-RULE-070 and automated regression guardrail.

incidents.title: Causal attribution overclaims from observational multi-seed recurrence
incidents.description: C10 report claimed hypotheses regarding UNet pooling dilution and parent scarcity were 'CONFIRMED' or 'PROVEN' based on observational recurrence in two seeds, without interventional ablation isolation.
incidents.root_cause: Confusing empirical reproducibility across seeds with causal mechanism proof.
incidents.corrective_action: Enacted strict epistemic tagging hierarchy (OBSERVED, SUPPORTED, PLAUSIBLE, CAUSAL_ESTABLISHED); enacted GOV-RULE-071 and regression tests.

incidents.title: Dense Class Index vs Source Label ID conflation in C11 report ('Class 6 (OF)' instead of Dense 5 / Source 6)
incidents.description: C11 report narrative stated 'Class 6 (OF) = Ocean Front (Source Label 6)'. In the authoritative dense mapping, OF is Dense Index 5; Dense Index 6 is POW (Pure Ocean Wave, Source Label 7). This created confusion between dense classification channels and source label IDs.
incidents.root_cause: Informal prose referencing source label index as model class index without distinguishing indexing spaces.
incidents.corrective_action: Audited complete mapping in exp07_p0_c12_c11_residual_audit_v1.json; codified GOV-RULE-073 requiring explicit index space attribution; added regression tests.

incidents.title: SAR physical sensor measurement vs runtime uncalibrated DN representation conflation
incidents.description: C11 report stated that Sentinel-1 measures normalized radar backscatter cross-section (sigma0), and casually referred to the runtime input tensor as sigma0 backscatter. In reality, EXP-07 operates on uncalibrated 10x10 spatially aggregated digital numbers (DN) transformed via log1p and standardized.
incidents.root_cause: Imprecise physics terminology in reporting layer failing to distinguish raw detected DN from radiometrically calibrated sigma0.
incidents.corrective_action: Established formal distinction in exp07_p0_c12_c11_residual_audit_v1.json; codified GOV-RULE-074 requiring precise 'SAR-derived detected DN-domain representation' terminology; added regression guardrails.

incidents.title: Pseudo-replication risk: Along-track consecutive Sentinel-1 slices mistaken for independent parent scenes
incidents.description: During initial candidate selection, consecutive along-track slices (e.g. 20151031t215610 and 20151031t215635) sharing mission datatake ID 00bde6 and orbit 8402 were evaluated as separate scenes. Slices from the same orbit pass share spatial continuity and atmospheric regimes.
incidents.root_cause: Relying on slice-level file naming rather than mission datatake ID and zero-Doppler along-track timing.
incidents.corrective_action: Implemented datatake clustering in parent identity audit exp07_p0_c13_parent_identity_audit_v1.json; clustered 457 scenes into 373 true independent datatakes; codified GOV-RULE-077.
